title: memory-audit/1
description: $VAULT/memory/audit.jsonl — one line per promotion, demotion, expiry, merge or flag. Writer: memory-keeper. This is what stops memory being a black box.

file.description: Vault-relative path of the memory file.

contradicts.description: Set on flag_contradiction. Contradictions are SURFACED, never silently resolved — the resolution might be 'the preference was wrong' or 'this was an exception', and only the human knows which.
